high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by Kendall Jenner. The post shows Kendall Jenner sitting on a dark wooden rocking chair with a woven seat and backrest. She is wearing a white dress with a ruffled collar and short sleeves, paired with black knee-high boots and white socks. Her hair is styled in loose waves, and she has her hands placed near the center of her chest. The background consists of a plain white wall and a brick floor, giving the setting a simple and clean aesthetic.
